method: Parse-only PyYAML BaseLoader node traversal; inspect fixed changed paths and unchanged workflow source. No workflow commands, tests, network or live API operations.

directConcurrencyAssessment.authorityPRCIcapabilityMissionTI: All five workflow groups contain github.sha and no job group. Distinct future head/synthetic SHA gives distinct group, preserving old1bac runs. Root must freshly authenticate the new synthetic identity before claiming distinct groups.
directConcurrencyAssessment.paperScopeCallee: No root/job concurrency or nested reusable call.
directConcurrencyAssessment.pathScope: New helper, fixture and RELEASE_READINESS do not match other PR-specific filters; existing delivery test continues capability trigger. docs.yml is manual dispatch only.
directConcurrencyAssessment.sourceBranchPush: No universal source-branch push is caused by these4 paths. Exact root-held source branch must be checked against retained push branch filters; any branch matching an explicit historical release/demo allowlist could create extra runs. This plan does not invent a branch name or assert a fresh ref lease.

unchangedCompletionTriggeredFollowers.trigger: PR CI completed (all conclusions); no new direct PR trigger
unchangedCompletionTriggeredFollowers.risk: Same upstream workflow_id and source head_branch can share a running/pending CI Health group across old/new heads. Running work is not cancelled by concurrency; default pending-slot replacement can affect a pending follower. Root should retain existing follower/run observations and distinguish this downstream risk from the six original PR producers. Existing watchdog commands may rerun failed/cancel stale according to unchanged policy; no such manual operation was performed.

unchangedCompletionTriggeredFollowers.trigger: PR CI or Smoke completed; triage job only on failure for workflow_run
unchangedCompletionTriggeredFollowers.risk: No concurrency pending/running collision; no manual rerun/dispatch requested.

inactiveReason: Not selected by PR4859 changed paths or normal non-allowlisted feature-branch push; no main push/manual dispatch is authorized here.

workflowRunJobConditions.prepare:
github.repository == 'MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0' && ((github.event_name != 'workflow_run' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') ||
 (github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.action == 'completed' &&
  github.event.workflow_run.name == 'Agent release acceptance' &&
  github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
  github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main' &&
  github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository &&
  github.event.workflow_run.repository.full_name == github.repository &&
  (github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' ||
   github.event.workflow_run.event == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
   github.event.workflow_run.event == 'workflow_call')))
